description: Flat per-cell-line metadata fields for experiments involving differentiation of induced pluripotent stem cells derived from fibroblasts into cardiomyocytes.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual iPSC line or experimental record.

donor_id.descr: Unique identifier for the original fibroblast donor/sample, if available.

donor_age_years.descr: Age of the donor at tissue collection, in years.

donor_sex.descr: Biological sex of the donor; use controlled terms such as female, male, intersex, or unknown.

donor_ethnicity.descr: Self-reported or recorded ethnicity/ancestry of the donor, if available.

donor_disease_status.descr: Clinical status of the donor relevant to the line, such as healthy, affected, carrier, or unknown.

starting_cell_type.descr: Starting somatic cell type used for reprogramming; expected value here is skin fibroblast or a more specific fibroblast subtype.

starting_tissue_source.descr: Anatomical source of the starting cells, if more specific than skin.

reprogramming_method.descr: Method used to generate iPSCs, such as viral transduction, episomal vectors, Sendai virus, mRNA, or other.

reprogramming_factors.descr: Reprogramming factor cocktail used, e.g. OCT4/SOX2/KLF4/c-MYC (Yamanaka factors) or variants thereof.

reprogramming_efficiency_percent.descr: Efficiency of iPSC generation from starting fibroblasts, reported as percent (%) or fraction converted to percent.

clonal_or_polyclonal.descr: Indicates whether the iPSC line was derived as a single clone or as a pooled/polyclonal population.

genetic_background_description.descr: Free-text description of the donor or line genetic background, including ancestry, family background, or notable genotypes.

genotype_marker.descr: Key genotype, variant, haplotype, or mutation information relevant to the line, if available.

pluripotency_markers_positive.descr: Whether the line tested positive for standard pluripotency markers (e.g. OCT4, NANOG, SOX2).

karyotype_status.descr: Karyotype result or chromosomal stability status, e.g. normal, abnormal, mosaic, or unknown.

quality_control_notes.descr: Summary of line quality-control findings, contamination status, or other relevant validation notes.

passage_number_at_differentiation_start.descr: Passage number of the iPSC line when cardiomyocyte differentiation was initiated.

cell_density_at_plating.descr: Cell density used at seeding/plating for differentiation initiation, in cells per cm^2 or the study-specified unit.

substrate.descr: Cell culture substrate or coating used, such as Matrigel, vitronectin, laminin, gelatin, or feeder layer.

media_composition.descr: Description of basal medium and supplements used during maintenance or differentiation, including key components.

oxygen_condition.descr: Oxygen level during culture, e.g. normoxia, hypoxia, or specific % O2 if recorded.

temperature_celsius.descr: Culture temperature during maintenance or differentiation, in degrees Celsius.

feeding_frequency_days.descr: Interval between media changes/feedings, in days.

differentiation_protocol_name.descr: Name or shorthand of the cardiomyocyte differentiation protocol used, if applicable.

differentiation_method.descr: Primary differentiation strategy, e.g. Wnt modulation, embryoid body formation, monolayer directed differentiation, or other.

small_molecule_treatments.descr: Free-text list of small molecules, cytokines, or pathway modulators used during differentiation, including timing if available.

genetic_modification_applied.descr: Whether any genetic modification was introduced to enhance cardiomyocyte differentiation.

genetic_modification_type.descr: Type of genetic modification, such as overexpression, knockout, knock-in, CRISPR editing, or transgene insertion.

genetic_modification_target.descr: Gene or genomic target of the introduced modification, if any.

genetic_modification_method.descr: Method used for genetic modification, such as CRISPR-Cas9, lentiviral transduction, piggyBac, or electroporation.

genetic_modification_effect_notes.descr: Observed or intended effect of the modification on cardiomyocyte differentiation, maturation, or function.

differentiation_duration_days.descr: Total duration of the cardiomyocyte differentiation process, in days.

cardiomyocyte_yield_percent.descr: Proportion of differentiated cells identified as cardiomyocytes, reported as percent (%).

differentiation_efficiency_metric.descr: Definition of the reported differentiation efficiency metric, e.g. percent cTnT-positive cells, beating areas, or qPCR-based score.

beating_onset_day.descr: Day post-induction when spontaneous beating first appeared, if observed.

contractility_measurement.descr: Quantitative measure of cardiomyocyte contractile performance, if recorded, with unit or assay name in the description text.

electrophysiology_readout.descr: Summary or numeric readout of electrophysiological function, such as action potential duration, field potential duration, or ion channel activity.

calcium_transient_measurement.descr: Calcium-handling functional readout, such as amplitude, decay time, or frequency, with units if available.

sarcomere_organization_score.descr: Score or quantitative assessment of sarcomere organization/maturation, if measured.

metabolic_maturation_marker.descr: Metabolic maturation marker or assay result, such as oxidative phosphorylation markers, if measured.

epigenetic_marker_notes.descr: Epigenetic markers or chromatin state features associated with the line or differentiation outcome, if assessed.

batch_id.descr: Identifier for the experimental batch, differentiation run, or production lot.

technical_replicate_id.descr: Identifier for the technical replicate corresponding to this record, if applicable.

biological_replicate_id.descr: Identifier for the biological replicate corresponding to this record, if applicable.

date_of_differentiation_start.descr: Date when cardiomyocyte differentiation was initiated.

date_of_assay.descr: Date when the main differentiation outcome or functional assay was performed.

operator_id.descr: Identifier for the researcher or technician who performed the experiment, if tracked.

notes.descr: Any additional relevant free-text notes that do not fit other fields.
